digest.component_or_area: Jira DataCenter backend outbound comment send path
propositions: Jira DataCenter outbound comment send path applies no length fitting, passing over-length bodies directly to the Jira client unfitted, causing rejection and re-emission in sync loops
_DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment exists but has no production callers; only test files reference it, leaving the DC send path unguarded
The dedup key (_DCSanitizer.fit_comment) is out of sync with what the send path actually lands, violating the e339 consistency contract
DC send path must wire _DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment through JiraDataCenterBackend.add_comment using fit_preserving_marker to maintain RECONCILER_MARKER while respecting deployment-resolved ceiling
_DCSanitizer.fit_comment must be re-derived via fit_comment_as_sent to match the marker-stripped body that the fitted send actually lands
